fields.label: Messages on screen
fields.help: The most chat lines shown at one time.

fields.label: Message stays (seconds)
fields.help: How long a chat line stays before it fades away.

fields.label: Slide time (seconds)
fields.help: How long a line takes to slide in or out.

fields.label: Hide chat commands
fields.help: Does not show lines that start a command, such as !sr.

fields.label: Default color
fields.help: The color for viewers who have no chat color.

fields.label: Animation timing and easing
fields.help: Delays, durations and easing of each part of a chat line. This is a group of values; it is shown here but is edited in the code editor.

fields.label: Chat line features
fields.help: Switches for badges, pronouns, colors, shine, link previews and emotes. This is a group of values; it is shown here but is edited in the code editor.
